cols.text: Each row shows one layout in four frames, left to right: writing an equation, finding a symbol, after Copy, and the 820 px pop-out window. The first three are the side panel at 400 px. Styling is plain grey on purpose.

capA.text:
A – Stage and dock
The equation takes the top third. Copy stays pinned at the bottom. Symbols sit between.

capB.text:
B – Tabs
Symbols, Draw, Library and Shortcuts are four tabs under the equation. Nothing hides in a menu.

capC.text:
C – One box
One search box finds symbols, saved equations and commands. Only recent symbols show until you type.

capD.text:
D – Keyboard
A maths keypad is docked at the bottom like a phone keyboard. Copy sits in the top bar.

capE.text:
E – Rail
Tools live on a side rail that is always visible. The window gets a labelled sidebar and two columns.

capF.text:
F – Scratchpad
A running list of equations. Each line copies with one press, and old lines stay for reuse.
